subject: Mathematics
source_note: Compiled from the NTA JEE Main 2026 Information Bulletin / official syllabus as reported by multiple 2025-2026 coaching/exam-tracker sources (careers360), cross-checked Sep 2026. The 2024-25 rationalisation dropped Mathematical Induction and Mathematical Reasoning as standalone units entirely, and trimmed portions of several remaining units (see syllabus_change_note fields). Always verify against the current-year NTA information bulletin (jeemain.nta.nic.in) before finalising a question bank, since NTA can revise the syllabus PDF between sessions.
exam_pattern_note: JEE Main Paper 1 Mathematics: 25 questions total (Section A: 20 single-correct MCQs, Section B: 5 numerical-value questions, all 25 compulsory since the 2025 pattern change removed the earlier 'attempt any 5 of 10' choice in Section B). No multiple-correct or matrix-match question types appear in JEE Main (those are JEE-Advanced-only formats).

subtopics: Sets and their representation; union, intersection, complement and their algebraic properties; power set
Relations: types of relations, equivalence relations
Functions: one-one, into and onto functions, composition of functions
Complex numbers as ordered pairs of reals, a+ib form, Argand diagram
Algebra of complex numbers, modulus and argument (amplitude)
Quadratic equations in real and complex number systems and their solutions
Relation between roots and coefficients, nature of roots, formation of quadratic equations with given roots
topics.syllabus_change_note: 2025 rationalisation dropped the standalone 'triangle inequality' and 'square root of a complex number' as separately examinable sub-items.

subtopics: Matrices, algebra of matrices, types of matrices
Determinants of matrices of order two and three, evaluation of determinants, area of a triangle using determinants
Adjoint and inverse of a square matrix using determinants
Test of consistency and solution of simultaneous linear equations in two or three variables using determinants and matrices
topics.syllabus_change_note: 2025 rationalisation dropped 'elementary transformations' and a standalone 'properties of determinants' derivation-heavy sub-item as separately examinable.

subtopics: Fundamental principle of counting
Permutation as an arrangement and combination as selection
Meaning of P(n,r) and C(n,r), simple applications

topics.chapter: Binomial Theorem and its Simple Applications
subtopics: Binomial theorem for a positive integral index
General term and middle term
topics.syllabus_change_note: 2025 rationalisation dropped 'properties of binomial coefficients' as a separately examinable derivation-heavy sub-item.

subtopics: Arithmetic and geometric progressions
Insertion of arithmetic and geometric means between two given numbers
Relation between A.M. and G.M.
topics.syllabus_change_note: 2025 rationalisation dropped 'sum up to n terms of special series (Σn, Σn², Σn³)' and 'arithmetico-geometric progression' as separately examinable sub-items.

subtopics: Real-valued functions, algebra of functions; polynomial, rational, trigonometric, logarithmic and exponential functions; inverse functions; graphs of simple functions
Limits, continuity and differentiability
Differentiation of sum, difference, product and quotient of two functions
Differentiation of trigonometric, inverse trigonometric, logarithmic, exponential, composite and implicit functions; derivatives up to order two
Applications of derivatives: rate of change of quantities, monotonic increasing/decreasing functions, maxima and minima of functions of one variable, tangents and normals
topics.syllabus_change_note: 2025 rationalisation dropped 'Rolle's and Lagrange's Mean Value Theorems' as a separately examinable sub-item.

subtopics: Integral as an anti-derivative
Fundamental integrals involving algebraic, trigonometric, exponential and logarithmic functions
Integration by substitution, by parts, and by partial fractions; integration using trigonometric identities
Fundamental Theorem of Calculus, properties of definite integrals, evaluation of definite integrals
Determining areas of regions bounded by simple curves in standard form
topics.syllabus_change_note: 2025 rationalisation dropped 'integral as a limit of a sum' as a separately examinable sub-item.

subtopics: Ordinary differential equations, their order and degree
Formation of differential equations
Solution of differential equations by the method of separation of variables
Solution of homogeneous and linear differential equations
Cartesian system of rectangular coordinates in a plane, distance formula, section formula, locus and its equation
Slope of a line, parallel and perpendicular lines, intercepts of a line on the coordinate axes
Straight lines: various forms of equations, intersection of lines, angle between two lines, conditions for concurrence of three lines, distance of a point from a line
Equations of internal/external bisectors of angles between two lines; coordinates of centroid, orthocentre and circumcentre of a triangle

Circles and conic sections: standard and general form of the equation of a circle, radius and centre, equation of a circle given diameter endpoints, points of intersection of a line and circle, equation of the tangent
Sections of cones; equations of parabola, ellipse and hyperbola in standard forms
topics.syllabus_change_note: 2025 rationalisation dropped 'translation of axes', 'equation of family of lines through the intersection of two lines', and 'condition for y=mx+c to be a tangent to a circle and point(s) of tangency' as separately examinable sub-items.

subtopics: Coordinates of a point in space, distance between two points, section formula
Direction ratios and direction cosines, angle between two intersecting lines
Skew lines: the shortest distance between them and its equation
topics.syllabus_change_note: 2025 rationalisation dropped 'equations of a line and a plane in different forms, intersection of a line and a plane, and coplanar lines' as separately examinable sub-items — this is the most heavily trimmed unit in the 2025-26 syllabus.

subtopics: Vectors and scalars, addition of vectors
Components of a vector in two-dimensional and three-dimensional space
Scalar and vector products of two vectors
topics.syllabus_change_note: 2025 rationalisation dropped 'scalar and vector triple product' as a separately examinable sub-item.

subtopics: Measures of dispersion: mean, median, mode of grouped and ungrouped data
Calculation of standard deviation, variance and mean deviation for grouped and ungrouped data
Probability of an event, addition and multiplication theorems of probability, Baye's theorem
Probability distribution of a random variate
topics.syllabus_change_note: 2025 rationalisation dropped 'Bernoulli trials and binomial distribution' as a separately examinable sub-item.

subtopics: Trigonometrical identities and equations
Trigonometrical functions
Inverse trigonometrical functions and their properties
topics.syllabus_change_note: 2025 rationalisation dropped 'heights and distances' as a separately examinable sub-item.
